summary: FD_ED_TC_17_Passenger | Split PNR from Group | Originator Office ID | Group Treatment | Individual Claim
title: Passenger | Split PNR from Group | Originator Office ID | Group Treatment | Individual Claim
description:
Customer's PNR was split from a group booking. The originator office ID still identifies it as a group-origin booking. Per call transcript: "When a group PNR is split, the originator office ID remains the same, and the booking is still considered a group booking for eligibility and reporting purposes."

Prerequisites:
PNR: TCED17 (split from group GRP-2026-0520); Originator office ID: YYZAC1234 (same as original group); 1 passenger on split PNR: "Priya Sharma"; 1 leg AC (YYZ?YVR); Delay 4 hrs; Code 42; APPR
